Why Salute Sync reads this data

Salute Sync reads only the Health Connect data you allow: steps, distance, floors, elevation, speed, power, calories, workouts, sleep and stages, weight and body measurements, heart rate, variability, oxygen, blood pressure, glucose, temperature, respiration, VO2 max, nutrition, and hydration.

Once a day, or when you tap Sync now, the app sends JSON to the webhook address you pasted. The URL and key stay on the phone, encrypted. There is no Salute Sync server, no analytics, and no third-party trackers.

You can revoke permissions at any time in Health Connect. Without background read, the automatic sync cannot read while the screen is off. Without history read, the import covers only about 30 days before the first grant.
